a fundamental change: The internet has brought a fundamental change to the way people shop, study, and communicate with each other.
網路為人們購物、讀書和彼此溝通的方式帶來了根本的改變。
be fundamental to: Doctors say that enough sleep and clean water are fundamental to good health for teenagers.
醫生說，充足的睡眠和乾淨的水是青少年良好健康的根本。
fundamental rights: Freedom of speech and the right to vote are fundamental rights that every citizen should enjoy.
言論自由和投票權是每位公民都應享有的基本權利。
a fundamental difference: There is a fundamental difference between reading to understand and simply memorizing answers for a test.
為了理解而閱讀和只是為了考試背答案之間有根本的差異。
fundamental principles: Honesty and respect are the fundamental principles on which all of our school rules are built.
誠實和尊重是我們所有校規所建立的基本原則。
be furious with someone: Mom was furious with my brother when he came home at two in the morning without calling her.
我哥哥凌晨兩點才回家又沒打電話，媽媽對他大發雷霆。
be furious at the decision: Many fans were furious at the decision to cancel the concert just one hour before it started.
許多歌迷對在開演前一小時取消演唱會的決定極為憤怒。
a furious argument: The two neighbors had a furious argument about parking, shouting at each other in the street.
這兩位鄰居為了停車問題激烈地爭吵，在街上對彼此大吼大叫。
at a furious pace: With the bus about to leave, he ran down the street at a furious pace and just made it.
公車就要開走了，他以飛快的速度沿著街跑去，剛好趕上。
work at a furious rate: With only an hour left before the deadline, the students had to work at a furious rate, rushing to finish their posters.
離截止時間只剩一小時，學生們必須拚命地工作，趕著完成海報。
genetic engineering: Thanks to genetic engineering, scientists can now grow rice that survives long periods without rain.
多虧了基因工程，科學家現在能種出可以在長期無雨下存活的稻米。
a genetic disorder: The doctor explained that the boy has a genetic disorder that was passed down from his parents.
醫生解釋說，那個男孩患有一種由父母遺傳下來的遺傳疾病。
genetic makeup: Your genetic makeup, which comes from both parents, decides things like your eye color and height.
你的基因組成來自父母雙方，決定了像眼睛顏色和身高這類的特徵。
genetically modified food: Some shoppers carefully read labels because they want to avoid genetically modified food such as certain kinds of corn.
有些消費者會仔細閱讀標籤，因為他們想避免某些玉米之類的基改食品。
a genuine leather bag: The seller promised it was not fake but a genuine leather bag made by hand in Italy.
賣家保證那不是假貨，而是在義大利手工製作的真皮包。
genuine concern: She showed genuine concern for her sick classmate, visiting him in the hospital every day after school.
她對生病的同學表現出真誠的關心，每天放學後都到醫院探望他。
a genuine mistake: I didn't take your umbrella on purpose; it was a genuine mistake because ours look exactly the same.
我不是故意拿走你的雨傘；那是無心之過，因為我們的傘看起來一模一樣。
the genuine article: Many cheap copies of this watch are sold online, but this one in the shop is the genuine article.
網路上賣著許多這款手錶的廉價仿品，但店裡的這一支是真貨。
genuine interest: Our teacher has a genuine interest in her students' lives and always remembers what we tell her.
我們老師對學生的生活有真正的興趣，總是記得我們告訴她的事。
a gifted child: Lily could play the piano at age three, so her teachers soon realized she was a gifted child.
莉莉三歲就會彈鋼琴，所以她的老師們很快就發現她是個資優兒童。
be gifted with: The young singer seems to be gifted with a beautiful voice that moves everyone who hears it.
這位年輕歌手似乎天生具有一副打動每位聽眾的美妙嗓音。
gifted and talented students: Our school offers a special science program for gifted and talented students who learn faster than others.
我們學校為學得比別人快的資賦優異的學生開設特別的科學課程。
a gigantic task: Cleaning up the whole town after the typhoon was a gigantic task that took the army several weeks.
颱風過後清理整個城鎮是一項艱鉅的任務，軍隊花了好幾週才完成。
a gigantic effort: It took a gigantic effort from hundreds of volunteers to rebuild the old bridge in just one month.
數百名志工付出了巨大的努力，才在短短一個月內重建了那座舊橋。
gigantic losses: The airline suffered gigantic losses of millions of dollars when flights were stopped during the storm.
暴風雨期間航班停飛時，這家航空公司蒙受了數百萬美元的巨額虧損。
global warming: Because of global warming, summers in Taiwan are getting hotter and sea levels are slowly rising.
由於全球暖化，台灣的夏天越來越熱，海平面也慢慢上升。
the global economy: When oil prices rise sharply, the global economy suffers and many countries face higher living costs.
當油價急遽上漲時，全球經濟受到衝擊，許多國家都面臨更高的生活成本。
a global perspective: Studying abroad gave me a global perspective on problems that affect people in many different countries.
出國留學讓我以全球視野看待影響許多不同國家人民的問題。
global citizenship: The course on global citizenship teaches students to care about poverty and climate problems around the world.
這門世界公民課程教導學生關心全世界的貧窮與氣候問題。
go global: The small Taiwanese bubble tea shop plans to go global by opening new stores in Europe and America.
這家台灣小手搖飲店計畫走向國際，在歐洲和美國開設新店。
